- region "Trip budget calculator":
  - heading "Trip budget calculator" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Enter your own amounts in PLN. An empty field means an unknown cost; enter 0 if there is no expense or it is already included elsewhere.
  - paragraph: A known flight price is copied from the offer per person and covers only its legs. Add a missing return to the flight amount if it is absent from the offer; do not count it again if already included. This is an observed price, not a booking confirmation. Other amounts are your estimates or manually entered prices; we do not verify them with sellers.
  - group "Calculator mode":
    - button "Quick budget" [pressed]
    - button "Detailed budget"
  - paragraph: Both modes include all entered costs and events. Switching modes keeps your amounts. Expand the details to fill in missing costs.
  - group: How are costs calculated?
  - paragraph: Draft saved in this browser. Refreshing the page does not delete it.
